title: Enterprise CRM & Client Portal
overview: A multi-tenant CRM platform giving sales teams a unified view of clients, deals, and support tickets, with a dedicated client-facing self-service portal.
problem: The client managed customers across spreadsheets, email threads, and a support inbox with no shared source of truth, causing dropped follow-ups and duplicated work across teams.
solution: Designed and built a role-based CRM with a React/TypeScript frontend and a Node.js REST API, backed by a normalized PostgreSQL schema, with a separate authenticated portal for clients to track their own projects and tickets.
architecture: React SPA talking to a Node.js/Express API over REST, JWT-based auth with role-based access control, PostgreSQL for relational data, Redis for session and rate-limit caching, deployed on AWS EC2 behind Nginx with Docker Compose.
features: Role-based dashboards for admins, sales reps, and clients
Deal pipeline with stage tracking and activity history
Client self-service portal with ticket tracking
REST API with versioned endpoints and rate limiting

title: Containerized CI/CD Pipeline on Kubernetes
overview: A fully automated build-test-deploy pipeline that takes a commit from pull request to a running pod in a Kubernetes cluster with zero manual steps.
problem: Releases were deployed manually by SSH-ing into a server and pulling the latest code, leading to inconsistent environments and occasional downtime during deploys.
solution: Containerized the application with Docker, wrote a GitHub Actions pipeline to build, test, and push images to a registry, and configured Kubernetes manifests with rolling updates and health checks for zero-downtime deployment.
architecture: GitHub Actions for CI, Docker multi-stage builds, a private container registry, Kubernetes Deployments with readiness/liveness probes, Helm-style manifests, and Prometheus/Grafana for cluster monitoring.
features: Automated image build, scan, and push on every merge
Environment parity between staging and production

title: Cloud Infrastructure Migration & Hardening
overview: Migrated a legacy shared-hosting application to a scalable, secured cloud infrastructure with automated backups and monitoring.
problem: The application was running on aging shared hosting with no backup strategy, no monitoring, and frequent downtime during traffic spikes.
solution: Re-architected the hosting setup on AWS using EC2 and RDS, introduced Nginx as a reverse proxy with SSL termination, automated nightly backups, and set up uptime and resource monitoring with alerting.
architecture: AWS EC2 + RDS, Nginx reverse proxy with Let's Encrypt SSL, automated snapshot backups, CloudWatch and Grafana dashboards, Terraform-managed infrastructure for reproducibility.
features: Automated nightly backups with retention policy
SSL and DNS fully automated and monitored

title: Field Service Mobile App with Admin Dashboard
overview: A cross-platform field service app for technicians, paired with a web-based admin dashboard for scheduling and reporting.
problem: Field technicians relied on phone calls and paper job sheets, making it impossible for dispatchers to see job status in real time.
solution: Built a React Native app for technicians to receive, update, and close jobs in real time, backed by a Node.js API, with a React-based admin dashboard for dispatch and reporting.
architecture: React Native mobile client, Node.js/Express REST API, MongoDB for flexible job-record storage, React admin dashboard, hosted on a Dockerized VPS behind Nginx.
features: Real-time job status updates from the field
Admin dashboard for scheduling and dispatch
